output.title: Route53 not-found error fix: DNS solver configuration not shown
output.content: The fix corrects AWS Route53 error detection for not-found errors when deleting DNS records. It matters only if DNS-01 challenges are solved through Route53. The environment summary shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests or CRDs, so which solvers are configured is not visible. Check the issuers for a Route53 DNS-01 solver.
